newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Enersis Q1 net climbs.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enersis Q1 net climbs.

text.p: Chilean power investment company Enersis posted net earnings for the first quarter of 32.89 billion pesos, up 37.6 percent from the same period last year.
Nearly 30 percent of Enersis's profits came from its investments abroad, the company said in a statement.

"An important factor in this period was the notable growth in operating earnings in the company's electricity distribution divisions in Argentina and Peru," it said. "(These) rose 8.4 percent and 33.6 percent, respectively, backed by the vigorous economic growth in those countries."
